The trending headline says “intends to submit by year-end.” First, be clear about those two words: “intends” and “submit”—not that it has already been introduced to the Legislative Council, much less passed and become law.

On November 16, Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said at the Bloomberg Global Regulatory Forum held in Hong Kong that a bill would be submitted before the end of this year to complete the regulatory framework and extend licensing to institutions engaged in virtual asset dealing, advising, management and custody. The government’s press release published the full speech at 15:25 that day. The same point had already been made in the Legislative Council on November 4 by Joseph Chan, Acting Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury: the government and the Securities and Futures Commission would submit a bill to the Legislative Council before the end of this year to amend the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615), extending the regulatory regime currently applicable to virtual asset trading platforms to virtual asset dealing, advising, management and custody services. Today, the Financial Secretary reaffirmed that timetable.

For people in Hong Kong using related services, the key for now is to distinguish between what is already in operation and what is still going through the legislative process:

🔹 Already in place: The licensing regime for virtual asset trading platforms took effect in June 2023. The Stablecoins Ordinance (Cap. 656) took effect on August 1, 2025, and the HKMA issued two issuer licences in April this year. Paul Chan said today that both issuers have launched Hong Kong dollar stablecoins, and that 36 applications were received in the first round. He said the value of tokenized funds available to the public had grown about sevenfold over the past year. An official response on November 4 stated that two SFC-authorized tokenized money market funds had begun round-the-clock secondary-market trading on licensed platforms from October 26.

🔹 Not yet law: Under the proposals, dealing, advising, management and custody would require a licence from or registration with the SFC. Dealing would correspond to Type 1 regulated activity under the Securities and Futures Ordinance (dealing in securities), advising to Type 4, and management to Type 9. Custody would focus on the risks associated with safeguarding clients’ virtual asset private keys in Hong Kong. Unless exempt, anyone carrying on these four types of business in Hong Kong would have to be licensed by or registered with the SFC. Authorized institutions and licensees of stored value facilities would also have to register with the SFC if they wish to provide virtual asset services in Hong Kong. Anyone not licensed or registered would be prohibited from actively marketing these services to the Hong Kong public, whether in or outside Hong Kong.

🔹 No automatic transition to a licence: The authorities have stated that they do not intend to provide existing service providers with a transitional arrangement under which they would be “deemed to be licensed or registered.” They will take the time market participants need to adjust their businesses into account before setting an appropriate commencement date. That date has not yet been set. For now, existing services remain subject to the regimes already in effect for trading platforms and stablecoin issuers. Don’t mistake “a bill will be submitted before year-end” for “the new licences are already mandatory today.”

The principle is clear from the authorities: same business, same risks, same rules. After the bill is submitted to the Legislative Council, it will still need to go through scrutiny. The final text and commencement arrangements will be determined by the law as gazetted.

content:
热搜写的是「拟年底提交」，先把这两个词看清楚：是「拟」、是「提交」，不是已经交进立法会，更不是已经通过、已经生效的法。

11月16日，财政司司长陈茂波在香港举行的彭博全球监管论坛上说，今年年底前会提交法案，把监管边界补完，把发牌扩展到从事数字资产交易、提供意见、管理和托管的机构。政府新闻公报当天15:25发出演说全文。同一件事，署理财库局局长陈浩濂11月4日在立法会已经讲过：政府和证监会将于今年年底向立法会提交条例草案，通过修订《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》（第615章），把现时适用于虚拟资产交易平台的监管制度，扩展到虚拟资产交易、提供意见、管理及托管服务。今天是司长再次确认这个时间表。

在香港用相关服务的人，眼下先分清「已经在运转的」和「还在立法路上的」：

🔹 已经落地的：虚拟资产交易平台发牌制度2023年6月已实施。《稳定币条例》（第656章）2025年8月1日生效，金管局今年4月批出两个发行人牌照；陈茂波今天说，这两家都已推出港元稳定币，首轮共有36家申请。面向公众的代币化基金，他提到过去一年大约增了七倍；11月4日的官方答问写明，两只证监会认可的代币化货币市场基金已从10月26日起在持牌平台做全天候二级市场交易。

🔹 还没变成法的：拟议中的交易、提供意见、管理和托管，要向证监会申领牌照或注册。交易对标《证券及期货条例》第1类（证券交易），提供意见对标第4类，管理对标第9类；托管则聚焦在香港保管客户虚拟资产私钥相关的风险。除非获得豁免，在香港从事这四类业务必须获证监会发牌或注册；认可机构和储值支付工具持牌人若要在港提供虚拟资产服务，也须向证监会注册。未获发牌或注册，不得在香港或香港以外向香港公众积极推广这类服务。

🔹 不会自动过牌：官方已表明，不打算为现有服务提供者提供「被当作已获发牌或注册」的过渡安排；会考虑市场参与者调整业务所需时间，再订合适的生效日期。生效日还没定。现有服务先按已经实施的交易平台、稳定币发行人制度来，别把「年底前提交草案」听成「新牌照今天已经强制执行」。

原则官方讲得很清楚：相同业务、相同风险、相同规则。草案交到立法会以后还要经过审议，条文和生效安排以最终刊宪为准。

title: ‎Документ громадянина чи цифровий ключ до державної системи?
subTitle:
Паспорт чи ID-картка: документ громадянина чи цифровий ключ до державної системи?
DVA — факти без хайпу
ФАКТ • ПРАВО • ЦИФРОВІЗАЦІЯ • ПРИВАТНІСТЬ • РІШЕННЯ
«ID-картка — це посвідчення особи, а паспорт — це паспорт громадянина країни». Саме так часто пояснюють різницю між документами. У цій позиції є логіка, але українське законодавство використовує іншу термінологію. І за нею приховується значно цікавіше питання: чи має громадянин право самостійно обирати, у якій формі держава посвідчує його особу?
1. Назва документа — ще не вся його сутність
В Україні ID-картка офіційно називається паспортом громадянина України. Відповідно до статті 21 Закону №5492-VI, паспорт громадянина України є документом, який посвідчує особу та підтверджує громадянство України.
Те саме юридичне призначення мав і паспорт-книжечка зразка 1994 року. Тобто з погляду закону це не два документи з принципово різним статусом, а дві форми внутрішнього паспорта громадянина України.
Проте форма має значення. Книжечка — паперовий документ із надрукованими сторінками та відомостями. ID-картка — пластиковий документ із безконтактним електронним носієм, пов'язаний із цифровою інфраструктурою держави.
І тут виникає принципове питання: чи є перехід від паперового документа до електронного лише технічним оновленням, чи це зміна самої моделі взаємодії громадянина з державою?
2. Паспорт-книжечка: фізичний документ без електронного чипа
Паспорт зразка 1994 року мав важливу практичну властивість: основні ідентифікаційні відомості були безпосередньо нанесені на його сторінки. Для пред'явлення документа не потрібно було зчитувати електронний носій або відкривати державний цифровий сервіс.
Але це не означало повної незалежності від державного обліку. Відомості про громадян, видачу документів та реєстраційні дії також оброблялися державними органами й обліковими системами.
Отже, книжечка не була документом поза державними реєстрами. Її головна відмінність полягала в іншому: сам фізичний документ не містив безконтактного електронного чипа.

Для людини це означало можливість підтвердити особу за допомогою паперового оригіналу без обов'язкового використання смартфона, NFC або цифрового застосунку.
3. ID-картка: паспорт і елемент цифрової інфраструктури
ID-картка містить безконтактний електронний носій і пов'язана з Єдиним державним демографічним реєстром.
Завдяки цьому держава може використовувати цифрові механізми ідентифікації, а громадянин — отримувати доступ до електронних послуг.
Переваги очевидні: сучасні засоби захисту від підроблення, автоматизована перевірка даних, зручність електронної взаємодії, можливість використання цифрових документів у «Дії».
Але цифровізація має й інший бік.
Фізичний документ залишається у власника, проте частина процесів його перевірки та використання залежить від електронних систем, правильності записів у реєстрах, технічної інфраструктури та доступності відповідних сервісів.
Це не означає, що ID-картка небезпечна або що державні реєстри обов'язково використовуватимуться неправомірно. Однак це означає, що питання захисту персональних даних, кібербезпеки, доступу до інформації та контролю за її використанням стають особливо важливими.
4. Чому американська модель не зовсім така, як українська
Порівняння зі США допомагає зрозуміти різницю, але потребує уточнення.
У США є паспортна книжечка — Passport Book, паспортна картка — Passport Card, а також посвідчення особи штату та водійські посвідчення.
Паспортна книжечка дозволяє здійснювати міжнародні поїздки повітряним, морським і наземним транспортом. Паспортна картка підтверджує особу та громадянство США, але має обмежене призначення: нею можна користуватися для окремих міжнародних поїздок наземним і морським транспортом, зокрема до Канади та Мексики. Для міжнародних авіаперельотів вона не підходить.

Водночас State ID — це посвідчення особи, яке видається на рівні штату. Воно не є паспортом США і саме по собі не підтверджує громадянство.

Тому американська модель справді демонструє важливе розмежування: паспортні документи та внутрішні посвідчення особи мають різні функції.
В Україні ж ID-картка юридично залишається саме паспортом громадянина України, хоча її формат і спосіб використання нагадують пластикове посвідчення особи.
5. Найважливіше питання — чи існує право на альтернативу?
Це не лише теоретична дискусія.
19 вересня 2018 року Велика Палата Верховного Суду ухвалила постанову у зразковій справі №806/3265/17. Суд визнав протиправною відмову міграційної служби видати громадянці паспорт-книжечку через її незгоду на обробку персональних даних у запропонованому форматі ID-картки.
У рішенні Велика Палата звернула увагу на непропорційність втручання у приватне життя та необхідність поважати права людини.
Це важливий юридичний прецедент. Він показує, що питання форми паспорта пов'язане не тільки зі зручністю, а й із правом на приватність та свободою переконань.
Практика не залишилася лише історією 2018 року. 18 вересня 2026 року Верховний Суд повідомив про рішення Рівненського окружного адміністративного суду, який зобов'язав міграційну службу видати паспорт-книжечку 16-річній дівчині, котра відмовлялася від ID-картки з релігійних переконань.
Водночас важливо розуміти: це не означає, що кожен громадянин може просто прийти до ДМС і без додаткових процедур вимагати книжечку. На практиці оформлення такого документа досі може потребувати судового захисту.
6. Чи є цифровий паспорт повною заміною фізичного?
Застосунок «Дія» дозволяє використовувати цифрові паспортні документи у багатьох повсякденних ситуаціях. Цифрові документи мають юридичну силу у визначених законодавством випадках.
Але є технічна особливість: паспорт-книжечка зразка 1994 року не відображається в «Дії», оскільки відомості про нього містяться в картотеках, а не в тому цифровому форматі реєстрових даних, з якого формується е-документ.
Це створює нерівність у доступі до цифрових сервісів залежно від форми документа.

Важливо також не плутати внутрішній паспорт із закордонним. Для міжнародних поїздок Україна використовує окремий паспорт громадянина України для виїзду за кордон. Внутрішній паспорт — і книжечка, і ID-картка — не є універсальним документом для міжнародних подорожей.
7. Головна проблема — не пластик, а межі державного контролю
Держава має законний інтерес у достовірній ідентифікації громадян, протидії шахрайству, захисті документів від підроблення та розвитку електронних послуг.
Громадянин, зі свого боку, має право очікувати, що його персональні дані будуть захищені, оброблятимуться законно й використовуватимуться лише з визначеною метою.

Тому питання не повинно зводитися до протистояння «старого паперу» та «нового пластику».
Справжній критерій цифрової держави — не кількість електронних сервісів, а якість гарантій для людини.
Чи може громадянин отримати документ без електронного носія? Чи має він реальний вибір? Чи існує доступна процедура виправлення помилок у реєстрах? Чи може людина підтвердити особу, коли цифровий сервіс недоступний? Хто відповідає за витік або неправомірне використання персональних даних?
Це питання не про відмову від прогресу. Це питання про те, щоб прогрес не перетворювався на обов'язкову залежність від однієї технологічної системи.

Висновок DVA
Можна підтримувати цифровізацію і водночас захищати право на паперовий документ. Можна користуватися «Дією» і вимагати належного захисту персональних даних. Можна визнавати переваги ID-картки, але не погоджуватися з тим, що вона має бути єдиним прийнятним форматом для кожного громадянина.
Можливо, головна втрата для частини людей полягає не в тому, що вони обміняли книжечку на пластикову картку. А в тому, що разом із переходом до нової системи вони відчули зменшення власного вибору.

Держава повинна мати інструменти для ідентифікації громадян. Але громадянин не повинен втрачати право на приватність, гідність і реальну альтернативу.

$ETH A short position worth $2.04 million was liquidated during this bout of volatility in perpetual futures, with the price around 1,838.98.
Folks, what exactly is a liquidation? Here’s the short version👇
The amount reported is based on the position’s notional value, not the actual amount lost: in isolated margin mode, when a 10x leveraged position is liquidated, the loss is mainly the margin—about one-tenth of the notional value.
The key to leveraged trading is this: even if you end up being right about the direction, interim volatility can still wipe out your position first.
Learning to read indicators is easy. The hard part is sticking to your rules when emotions are running high.

subTitle:
🚨 Дроп-схеми: що реально змінює закон №5038-IX і до чого тут P2P/USDT
В Україні посилили кримінальну відповідальність за незаконні операції з платіжними інструментами та доступами до рахунків. Ініціатива №16013 стала законом №5038-IX.
Але важливо не панікувати й не спрощувати.
Що заборонено?
Не сама передача картки як така, а передача/придбання/зберігання платіжних інструментів, облікових даних або доступу до рахунків з метою вчинення шахрайства чи іншого кримінального правопорушення.
Покарання:
· передача власного інструмента з протиправною метою — штраф 5 100–17 000 грн;
· дії з чужими платіжними інструментами — штраф 51 000–85 000 грн, обмеження волі до 3 років або позбавлення волі 2–4 роки;
· повторно або організованою групою — штраф 85 000–170 000 грн або позбавлення волі 4–6 років.
Чи стосується Wise/Revolut?
Якщо це платіжний інструмент/рахунок/гаманець і його передають для шахрайської мети — іноземна назва сервісу не захищає. Але автоматично «всі Wise/Revolut під забороною» — це неправда.
А P2P і USDT?
Сам P2P-обмін криптовалюти не заборонений. Ризик виникає, коли:
· оплата надходить від третьої особи;
· використовуються чужі картки/рахунки;
· контрагент пов’язаний із шахрайськими схемами;
· ланцюг коштів незрозумілий.
Найнебезпечніша схема: ви продаєте USDT, а гривню отримуєте не від покупця, а від «лівої» особи. Якщо її рахунок був задіяний у шахрайстві — можливі блокування, перевірки та пояснення для банку.
Мінімальна гігієна:
1. Не передавайте картки, паролі, коди, seed-фрази.
2. Не приймайте оплату від сторонніх осіб.
3. Зберігайте докази P2P-угод.
4. Не «проганяйте» гроші через свою картку за відсоток.
5. Не використовуйте рахунки родичів для обходу лімітів.
Головне: закон не забороняє крипту, P2P чи некастодіальні гаманці. Він б’є по конкретних діях із платіжними доступами з протиправною метою. Але для P2P це сигнал: перевірка контрагента й походження коштів стає не опцією, а частиною безпеки.
Не фінансова порада. Не юридична консультація.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#ETH #Gas #BTC

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What’s the Fuel Cost of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel money.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to the token price】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain transactions late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operations can cost half as much.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s hard to trade futures without USDT, but many people haven’t thought about why it’s worth $1.

【How it works】The stablecoin is operated by its issuer: you give it $1, and it issues you 1 USDT and puts
dollars (and equivalent assets) into its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars goes to the issuer
to redeem it. This “mint-and-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price near $1.
The price may occasionally deviate slightly (for example, to $0.999), but arbitrageurs quickly trade away the difference.

title: ⚡ETHEREUM IS LOOKING TOWARD THE QUANTUM COMPUTING ERA: A NEW SECURITY DEVELOPMENT!
subTitle:
Blockchain security is becoming an important topic as quantum computing research advances.
A November 16 crypto development report highlights a new contribution from Ethereum developer Vansh Sahay, who submitted leanSPHINCS post-quantum signature code for Geth.
Here's why this development deserves attention.

🔴 1. What is the quantum computing threat?
Today's blockchain networks rely on cryptographic systems to secure transactions and digital ownership.
Powerful future quantum computers could potentially weaken some cryptographic methods currently used in the industry.
This is a long-term security concern, not evidence that existing blockchain encryption has already been broken.

🔴 2. What is leanSPHINCS?
leanSPHINCS is associated with hash-based digital signature technology.
Hash-based signatures are among the approaches researchers study for post-quantum security.
Their purpose is to develop cryptographic methods that can resist attacks from sufficiently powerful quantum computers.

🔴 3. Why does Geth matter?
Geth is a major Ethereum execution client.
Research and code contributions involving Geth can help developers explore possible security improvements within Ethereum's software ecosystem.
However, submitting code does not mean it has been accepted, deployed or activated on Ethereum mainnet.

🔴 4. What could happen next?
The wider Ethereum ecosystem will need continued research, testing, performance evaluation and coordination before any major cryptographic transition.

📊 My perspective:
Post-quantum security could become an important long-term development area for blockchain networks.
For $ETH  holders, this is a technical development worth following, although it does not provide an immediate bullish price signal.

💬 Community question:
Do you think quantum-resistant security will become a necessary feature for every major blockchain?
Share your thoughts.
DYOR. Not financial advice.
Important: This is an early-stage developer contribution, not a live Ethereum Mainnet upgrade. No immediate action is required from ETH holders.

Vitalik Buterin, the co-founder of Ethereum and a prominent figure in the cryptocurrency market, has made some important statements.

Scalability Goal on Ethereum!
Vitalik Buterin announced on November 16 that he supports EIP-8037, a proposal aimed at protecting both the scalability and security of the Ethereum network.

Buterin considered this arrangement to be the most viable way to strike a balance between network scalability and decentralization in the short term.
Buterin also stated that EIP-8037 aims to more accurately price persistent data growth on the network by increasing gas costs for the creation of new accounts, smart contracts, and data storage. This is intended to limit the storage and hardware load that could arise from increasing the gas limit.

On the other hand, Buterin pointed out that the new gas model could create compatibility issues in some existing smart contracts. He urged developers to review fixed gas limits and practices before the Glamsterdam upgrade.

Quantum Resistance for Ethereum!
Vitalik Buterin, in addition to his EIP-8037 proposal, also commented on leanPCS. He noted that his view on leanPCS has shifted from strong skepticism to a more positive perspective in recent weeks, suggesting that leanPCS could accelerate Ethereum’s transition to quantum-resistant cryptography.

Buterin also noted that current 65-byte Ethereum signatures could reach 1,000-6,000 bytes in quantum-resistant alternatives, raising scalability issues. He added that he considers leanPCS to be one of the solutions to mitigate this burden.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being flat is also a position—and the one seasoned traders use most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and volatility grind their capital away.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. Stay flat when you don’t understand the market,
Stay flat when bulls and bears are battling it out; stay flat after a few consecutive losses—the money you save in these three moments,
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital ready, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have bullets to fire. Hold on to your bullets.

title: 交易心理 | 比预测行情更重要的事：复盘你自己的单子
subTitle:
大部分人花90%的时间预测行情，花0%的时间复盘自己。方向反了。

每笔单子记三行字：为什么开（依据是什么）、哪里错/对（执行层面）、
下次怎么改（具体动作）。坚持一个月，你会震惊地发现：你亏损的
单子里有大量「同一类错误」在反复出现——比如总是止损后立刻反手、
总是盈利单拿不住。

行情会变，但你的行为模式不会自动变，除非你盯着它改。市场是最
诚实的老师，你的交割单就是成绩单。别只看账户余额，去翻交易记录。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own trades. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in execution), and
what you'll change next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover that your losses…
A lot of the same mistakes keep showing up in your trade log—for example, immediately reversing your position after a stop-loss,
or constantly cutting winning trades short.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

【Title: I just said XRP had peaked, and now it’s back down to 89 cents. What gives?】

XRP fell below 89 cents, hitting its lowest level since November 2024, while the supply of its associated stablecoin shrank by $17 billion.

I talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s been a new development. This latest sell-off has dragged XRP back down to 89 cents—worse than in November 2024, when the crypto market was surging. This price level actually isn’t unfamiliar: the last time XRP was this low was in July, when it soared to a record high of $3.60. Now, it’s down 75% from its peak, and its quarterly loss is already alarming at 36%. What’s even more painful is that the supply of the stablecoin tied to it suddenly shrank by $17 billion in a single month, adding direct pressure to XRP’s cash flows.

Market impact
- Short term: Bearish sentiment is spreading through the crypto world. XRP and ETH have both fallen back to August levels, and there have been clear outflows from XRP ETFs—the largest since March. This sell-off is weighing on confidence across the crypto market.
- Medium term: If stablecoin outflows continue, XRP could fall further and lose the psychological 8-cent level. Regulatory risks are also accumulating: last week, the EU released a new report questioning the authenticity of XRP trading.

My take
I’m currently bearish on XRP. In the short term, 8 cents is a key support level, but it’s a fragile one. If the stablecoin continues to shrink or regulatory concerns intensify, XRP could slide to 70 cents or even lower. Until there are clear signs of a reversal in this downtrend, I’d recommend sitting on the sidelines.

【标题：刚说XRP见顶，现在跌回89美分，凭什么？】

XRP跌破89美分，创2024年11月以来新低，同时其挂钩的稳定币供给缩水170亿美元。

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。XRP这波下跌直接打回89美分，比2024年11月还惨，当时加密市场正猛涨。这个价位其实不陌生，XRP上一次这么低是今年7月它创纪录飙到3.6美元的时候。现在呢，它从顶点跌了75%，这波季度跌幅已经吓人，达到36%。更扎心的是，跟它绑定的稳定币突然一个月缩水了170亿美元，这直接把XRP的现金流压力放大了。

对市场的影响
- 短期：看跌情绪在加密圈扩散，XRP和ETH都跌回8月位置，资金明显流出XRP ETF，规模创下3月最大纪录。这波下跌让整个币圈信心承压。
- 中期：如果稳定币持续流出，XRP可能进一步失守8美分心理关口。行业监管风险也在累积，上周欧盟还发了个新报告质疑XRP交易的真实性。

我的判断
目前看空XRP，短期内8美分是关键支撑位，但这个位置很脆弱。如果稳定币继续缩水，或者监管进一步发酵，XRP可能向70美分甚至更低滑落。这个下跌趋势没看到明确反转信号前，建议观望为主。

WATER CONTROLS FIRE — 水克火.

Let's explore the symbolism, then examine what the market evidence actually tells us.

1. WHY ETHEREUM AND NVIDIA BOTH REPRESENT FIRE 
In Chinese Five Element philosophy, Fire is associated with transformation, visibility, energy and activity.

The Pig branch, 亥, belongs to Water.
In the Five Element controlling cycle:
WATER CONTROLS FIRE — 水克火.
Symbolically, Water can represent restraint, cooling and the regulation of excessive Fire energy.
Now consider the financial headlines.
Ethereum is facing a difficult market environment.

This creates an interesting thematic comparison.
But there is an essential distinction:
The Ba Zi calendar did not cause these market declines.
A symbolic relationship cannot establish that an asset will fall, recover or reach a particular price.
At GingleAI, the purpose of Ba Zi is to explore a cultural perspective while using verifiable information to examine what is happening in financial markets.

3. THE MARKET REALITY: WHAT DO THE CHARTS SHOW? 
Here's where we move from symbolism to evidence.

Although Ethereum and NVIDIA share a Fire classification in our creative framework, their markets behave differently.

I’m taking a defensive stance. Binance’s official news recorded ETH falling below $1,800 at 09:03 UTC on November 16, with a price of about $1,797.56 at the time. When writing this, I also checked the 24-hour ETH/USDT market data on Binance: the price was about $1,797.83, with an intraday range of $1,787.11 to $1,842.85, down about 1.90% over 24 hours. The break below the round-number level has happened, but that is simply a price fact. It does not mean a new wave of institutional funds has already exited, nor should every intraday dip be attributed to a whale being liquidated. ETH is still among the top trending topics on Binance Square over the past six hours, and discussions of liquidations are also heating up; attention is not a substitute for evidence of fund flows.

I paid particular attention to Farside’s table of U.S. spot ETH funds. The complete row for November 13 shows total net inflows of $2.3 million, including $11.6 million flowing into FETH and $9.3 million flowing out of Grayscale ETH, so flows were mixed across products. Although the November 16 row shows a total of 0.0, the individual product columns still contain dashes. The data is incomplete, so it would be absolutely wrong to call this “zero inflows on Monday” or say that “funds have returned.” We need to wait for the data to be filled in before judging subscriptions and redemptions during U.S. trading hours. If the price rebounds tonight but fund flows remain unconfirmed, I’ll treat it as a technical recovery for now, not a resumption of the trend.

Why does this matter for ETH? The creation and redemption of ETF shares can change the pace at which institutions allocate to ETH through regulated products, but spot prices are also influenced by derivatives deleveraging, expectations for U.S. interest rates, and on-chain demand. A small net inflow on one day cannot offset large outflows in the preceding days; conversely, an unupdated table cannot prove that another wave of outflows has begun. Right now, $1,800 is the dividing line for sentiment and short-term positioning, $1,787 is the latest intraday low, and around $1,843 is the 24-hour high. I’d only be willing to revise my outlook upward if the price regains and holds above $1,800, then breaks through $1,843, while the completed fund data shows no sustained net outflows. If the price falls below $1,787 and fails to reclaim $1,800 on a rebound, the current recovery thesis should be dropped.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase a short or rush to buy the rebound. I’d only consider a small spot long after confirmation. The planned position would be no more than 5% of total capital. The entry trigger is for ETH to regain $1,800 and close an hourly candle above it, then hold above that level on a retest. If U.S. fund data subsequently shows continued large net outflows, I’d pass even if the price condition is met. The first target is $1,820, where I’d trim half the position; the second is around $1,843, where I’d halve the remaining position. I’d stop out if the price falls back below $1,787, or proactively close the position if two consecutive hourly candles close below $1,800. If none of these triggers occur, this remains only a plan—there is no trade or return. I wouldn’t increase leverage during low-liquidity hours; protecting the loss limit comes first.

Kirkpatrick. The public filing page (Docket No. 60617) lists its status as Designated and the date as 2026-11-16. The application materials were submitted between March 27 and November 16, 2026.

The designation order names TLD Markets, not Backpack. But the Form DCM cover page in the same public filing states that the designated contract market operates under the name Backpack Exchange and is located at 2 Embarcadero Ctr. in San Francisco.

Three days earlier, on November 13, the CFTC issued a separate registration order approving TLD Clearing, Inc. (doing business as Backpack Clearing) as a derivatives clearing organization (DCO). It was signed by Deputy Secretary Robert N. Sidman. The designation order requires contracts listed by the exchange to be cleared by a registered clearing organization. The trading venue and clearing operation are two affiliated companies with separate licenses.

A few points that matter directly to ordinary users👇

🔹 What exists now is a license, not a live trading platform. The designation order approves the company to “become a designated contract market”; it does not list any contracts or give a launch date.

🔹 The registration order specifies the scope of clearing: (i) margined futures and (ii) fully collateralized futures, options on futures, and swaps. The company’s press release says U.S. users will be able to trade leveraged crypto perpetuals, use fiat or crypto assets as collateral, cross-margin, and trade around the clock. That is the company’s own description; the designation order itself does not spell out these products individually. The company’s official account was also recruiting people for a waitlist that same day, so this should not be taken to mean orders can already be placed.

🔹 That same day, CFTC Chair Michael S. Selig issued a statement saying the Commission had approved a DCM designation and DCO registration for an entity that uses blockchain architecture to execute and settle derivatives contracts. The statement did not name the company; based on the public filings released that day, the entity designated on November 16 was TLD Markets. He emphasized that entities using new technology must still meet the same standards as traditional markets, including requirements for anti-money laundering, customer protection and asset segregation, market surveillance, financial resources, and risk management.

🔹 Don’t confuse this with another company: the designation date for the exchange entity under tZERO was November 10, earlier than this one. It should not be treated as the same approval.

🔹 What this could mean for users: people in the United States who want to trade crypto perpetuals in the future may have another onshore option regulated by the CFTC, rather than having to use only offshore platforms. But these are still leveraged products, which magnify both gains and losses. A license does not mean low risk, and it certainly does not mean you can open a position in your usual app today.

Practical advice: first check that the entity is TLD Markets / Backpack Exchange, then wait for an official listing announcement and review the contract list, margin requirements, and liquidation rules. Don’t treat “approved” as a signal to deposit funds and copy trades.

牌照批了，并不等于盘已经开了。美国商品期货交易委员会刚把 Backpack 在美国做衍生品交易和清算的两张资质给齐了。

美国时间11月16日，CFTC 在华盛顿签发指定令，批准 TLD Markets, Inc. 成为指定合约市场（DCM），由委员会秘书 Christopher J. Kirkpatrick 签署。公开备案页（案号 60617）状态为 Designated，日期就是 2026-11-16。申请材料的提交跨度，是 2026年3月27日到11月16日。

指定令正文写的是 TLD Markets，没有直接出现 Backpack。但同一套公开备案里的 Form DCM 封面写明：这家指定合约市场对外经营的名称是 Backpack Exchange，地址在旧金山 2 Embarcadero Ctr.。

再往前三天，11月13日，CFTC 另签注册令，批准 TLD Clearing, Inc.（商业名称 Backpack Clearing）成为衍生品清算机构（DCO），由副秘书 Robert N. Sidman 签署。指定令要求，交易所挂出的合约必须由已注册的清算机构清算。交易场所和清算是两家关联公司、两套牌照。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 现在有的是牌照，不是已经开张的交易盘。指定令批准的是「成为指定合约市场」，没有列出已挂牌合约，也没有上线日。

🔹 清算范围写进了注册令：允许清算（i）保证金期货，以及（ii）全额担保的期货、期货期权和互换。公司新闻稿则说，美国用户将能做加杠杆的加密永续、用法币或加密资产作抵押、交叉保证金、全天候交易——这是公司自己的说明，指定令正文没有逐条写上这些产品。官方账号同日还在招等候名单，不能理解成今天已经能下单。

🔹 同一天，CFTC 主席 Michael S. Selig 发表声明，称委员会批准了一家使用区块链架构执行和结算衍生品合约的机构的 DCM 指定和 DCO 注册。声明没有点名公司；结合当天公开备案，11月16日被指定的正是 TLD Markets。他强调，用新技术的机构仍要满足和传统市场一样的标准，包括反洗钱、客户保护与资产隔离、市场监察、财务资源和风险管理。

🔹 别和另一家混在一起：tZERO 旗下交易所主体的指定日期是 11月10日，比这次更早，不宜当成同一张批文。

🔹 对人的影响：人在美国、以后想做加密永续，可能会多一条受 CFTC 监管的在岸通道，而不只是去境外盘。但这仍是杠杆产品，盈亏会被放大。牌照不等于低风险，更不等于今天就能在常用 App 里开仓。

实用建议：先核对主体是不是 TLD Markets / Backpack Exchange，再等正式挂牌通知，看合约清单、保证金和强平规则。不要把「已获批」当成可以跟单入金。

Binance futures liquidations totaled approximately $3.12 million in the past hour, with long positions accounting for 18.7%. The largest liquidation was $ETH  ($879,000).
Folks, how does liquidation happen? Here’s the short version 👇
Liquidation (also called a forced liquidation) happens when losses on a leveraged position cause its margin to fall below the maintenance margin requirement. The system then closes the position according to its rules.
Large liquidations mean leverage on that side of the market is being flushed out. Some people think the market may calm down briefly after the flush, but that isn’t always the case.
Don’t place orders during the fastest-moving minutes of the market. Wait for the price move to play out before deciding.

Invesco Reserve Fund Launches on Ethereum | Current Size Just $80,000 | ETH Still Needs Confirmation

My view is that the direction of institutions testing the waters is positive, but I don’t equate “going on-chain” directly with buying pressure for ETH. The topic #InvescoStablecoinReservesFundLaunchesOnEthereum appeared on Binance Square. I checked the formal prospectus Invesco filed with the SEC on November 13: IROXX is a government money market fund designed to meet the reserve-asset needs of stablecoin issuers. It plans to hold eligible U.S. dollar cash, short-term U.S. Treasury securities, and repurchase agreements. The fund itself does not invest in stablecoins or their issuers. Superstate serves as the transfer agent, maintaining off-chain book-entry records and mapping digital shares onto designated public blockchains; the filing states that Ethereum is currently the designated chain. “On-chain shareholder registration” does not mean that all legal and operational data exist only on-chain, nor is this a fund that directly buys ETH.

More importantly, it’s worth checking the actual scale. Superstate’s official assets page currently lists 80,000 IROXX shares on Ethereum, with a net asset value of $1 per share, for a total size of about $80,000. That is the share volume currently shown—not all of Invesco’s assets under management, and certainly not trillions of dollars flowing into Ethereum. User-initiated on-chain actions such as share transfers and redemptions require gas. If more institutions put reserve shares on Ethereum over time, that could increase settlement activity. But a starting size of $80,000 offers virtually no measurable near-term conclusion about ETH supply and demand. I’ll keep watching for actual growth in share volume, transfer activity, whether holdings remain concentrated in a single holder, and whether stablecoin issuers formally use the product, rather than mistaking a product launch for mature adoption.

At around 11:52 a.m. Beijing time, ETH was trading at $1,831.44 on Binance Spot, up about 0.36% over 24 hours, with a low of $1,787.11 and a high of $1,866.89. Price remains within a broad range and has yet to confirm a sustained breakout in response to the new topic; nor can this gain be attributed to IROXX. $1,866.89 is key resistance above, while $1,787.11 is the downside invalidation level. If share volume grows but ETH continues to fail to break resistance, we’ll have to acknowledge that the narrative’s short-term impact on price is weaker than expected. If price falls below the low, the short-term bullish view is invalidated outright.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the current move. I’d only consider a small long position in spot ETH, with a maximum total position of 5%. The entry trigger would be ETH decisively moving above $1,866.89 and holding above $1,850 on a retest, while also confirming sustained share growth in IROXX or other institutional tokenized products—not just relying on headlines. After the trigger, I’d buy 2.5% first, then add another 2.5% if the retest holds. I’d initially target $1,900 and sell half there, then close the rest at $1,950. If price falls back to $1,820 after entry, I’d stop out. I’d also exit proactively if it fails to hold $1,866.89 within two days. If price first breaks below $1,787.11, I’d cancel the long plan and wouldn’t use leverage to bet on the institutional narrative.

Sources: Invesco’s IROXX prospectus filed with the SEC; Superstate’s assets page; Binance ETHUSDT market data. #InvescoStablecoinReservesFundLaunchesOnEthereum #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

$ETH: VWAP Explained with a Researcher’s Daydream

$ETH: ETH sits on an upward hourly direction while volume is above baseline, prompting a quick pause. Why does the volume‑weighted average price sometimes feel like a mysterious compass for a researcher who keeps a notebook open at every candle?

The dilemma is simple: VWAP is calculated by averaging each trade price weighted by its volume, then dividing by total volume for the chosen interval. In a thought experiment, imagine a spreadsheet that adds price multiplied by volume for every tick and then divides by the sum of volumes. The result gives a single line that moves with the market’s activity, but it does not guarantee any bounce or reversal. It merely reflects where most dollars have traded so far.

One useful rule to test is to compare the current price to the VWAP computed over the last daily window. If price sits above daily VWAP while relative volume is 2.01x baseline, a trader might view the market as buying‑biased, yet the observation alone cannot prove that bias will persist. A future closed‑candle that shows price slipping below VWAP while relative volume drops would weaken the interpretation.

The lesson: treat VWAP as a descriptive snapshot, not a predictive magic wand, and always look for a counterexample before solidifying a rule.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

🚨 FIVE YEARS OF DEAD WEIGHT FLUSHING OUT THE LAX RETAIL BAGHOLDERS IN $ETH 📉

Cycles of absolute sideways torture always feel like an endless winter to anyone trading on emotion. Smart money loves this exact flavor of retail despair because boredom-driven capitulation creates the cleanest multi-year accumulation floors. 🦈

While emotional tourists complain about stagnant charts, patient capital is systematically absorbing every ounce of liquidity left on the table. 📊 True regime shifts never announce themselves with fireworks; they bleed out the impatient until only conviction remains. 💡

💬 Are you positioning for the structural breakout or letting exhaustion trick you into selling the bottom? 👇

🏷️ #ETH #MarketCycles #SmartMoney #Crypto #Accumulation 

🔥 💎

$ETH has been stuck around 1,820 all morning, and after that drop from about 2,400 the 4h chart is just a tight box at 1,800-1,830. Boring candles, but the liquidation radar says it won't stay boring for long.

On NanoTrading's radar the big long stacks sit around 1,715-1,725 (one bucket at 1,714.7 showed about $36.5M, another at 1,724 about $28.6M). title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are a Blockchain’s Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay Gas fees to transfer funds, and Gas fees to mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform the computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more everyone rushes to execute transactions, and the higher the gas price (price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → Gas fees skyrocket. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they choose late-night hours or quiet market periods for on-chain operations. The same operation can cost half as much.

This is not another stablecoin you can casually trade on an exchange. Invesco has put a money market fund designed specifically to serve as reserves for payment stablecoins on Ethereum and begun issuing tokenized shares.

The fund’s full name is Invesco Stablecoin Reserves Onchain Fund, ticker IROXX. The prospectus is dated November 13, 2026. According to reports and on-chain records, the first issuance was completed on November 16. Etherscan currently shows a total supply of 80,008 IROXX shares and just 1 holder; Superstate’s asset page also lists a net asset value of $1 and assets of about $80,000. The sub-transfer agent is Superstate Services LLC, the investment adviser is Invesco Advisers, Inc., and the transfer agent is Invesco Investment Services.

It is not itself a stablecoin, nor does it invest in stablecoins or their issuers. It is a U.S. Rule 2a-7 government money market fund that aims to maintain a $1 net asset value per share, but this is not guaranteed, and the shares are not federally insured. The prospectus states that it invests only in cash, U.S. Treasury securities with a remaining maturity or original term of no more than 93 days, and overnight repurchase agreements collateralized by Treasury securities or cash—assets that qualify as eligible reserves for payment stablecoins under the GENIUS Act. The shares are primarily intended to be held by stablecoin issuers to back payment stablecoins they have already issued.

For ordinary users, these points matter most 👇

🔹 You can’t buy or spend it. Shares can only be purchased and transferred through the investor portal by wallets that have been registered with Superstate and added to the Allowlist; transfers to unregistered addresses will be restricted. This is not a token you can buy directly on a decentralized exchange or trading app, and you can’t use it to make U transfers.

🔹 The initial minimum is $1 million per fund account. The current prospectus and Superstate product page both state that the initial investment is $1 million, with no minimum for additional investments; Invesco or an intermediary may aggregate a master account and subaccounts. There is no sales charge. The prospectus lists an annual operating expense of 0.36%, while the advisory agreement commits to waiving fees down to 0.20%, at least through December 31, 2027. For now, with around $80,000 on-chain and only 1 holder, it remains a very small initial launch.

🔹 Redemptions have a clear cutoff time. Redemptions submitted through the investor portal before 5 p.m. Eastern Time (currently 6 a.m. the following day in Beijing) are processed at that day’s net asset value. They are typically paid by wire transfer the same day and no later than 7 days afterward. Requests submitted after 5 p.m. are processed at the next business day’s net asset value and are typically paid by wire transfer the following day. Third-party intermediaries may support paying redemption proceeds or dividends in USDC. You pay the gas fees for redemptions and peer-to-peer transfers; the adviser, Superstate, or their affiliates cover gas fees for subscriptions and dividend reinvestments.

🔹 The on-chain record is a shareholder register, not the fund’s investment portfolio moved on-chain. Ownership and transfers are authenticated on Ethereum in token form and combined with off-chain identity records to form the official shareholder register. The prospectus states that Ethereum is the only designated blockchain at present; shareholders will be notified if other networks are added in the future.

The stablecoins you commonly keep in your wallet won’t gain a redemption button because of this news. These are fund shares for issuers to park eligible reserves. Ordinary users cannot currently subscribe, and should not mistake them for on-chain Treasuries that anyone can freely buy.

它本身不是稳定币，也不投资稳定币或发行方。这是一只美国 Rule 2a-7 政府货币市场基金，目标是把份额净值维持在 1 美元，但不能保证，也没有联邦存款保险。招股书写明，它只投资现金、剩余期限或发行期限不超过 93 天的美国国债，以及以国债或现金抵押的隔夜回购，作为《GENIUS 法案》下支付型稳定币可以使用的合格储备资产。份额主要打算由稳定币发行方持有，用来支撑已经发行出去的支付型稳定币。

对普通人，这几条最要紧👇

🔹 你买不了，也花不了。份额只能由已经通过 Superstate 登记、进入 Allowlist 的钱包，在投资人门户申购和互转；转到未登记地址会被限制。这不是去中心化交易所或交易 App 里能直接下单的代币，更不能拿来当 U 转账付款。

🔹 门槛是每个基金账户初始 100 万美元。现行招股说明书和 Superstate 产品页都写明：初始投资 100 万美元，追加没有最低额；景顺或中介可以把主账户和子账户合并计算。销售费没有。年度运作费招股书列为 0.36%，顾问合同承诺减免到 0.20%，减免期至少到 2027 年 12 月 31 日。眼下链上大约 8 万美元、只有 1 个持有人，还是很小的起步规模。

title: 【交易观点】ETH RSI 25.3超卖，观望等企稳
subTitle:
【交易观点】ETH RSI 25.3超卖，观望等企稳

这是一篇交易观点分析，不是事实陈述，仅供参考。ETH日线RSI(14)跌至25.3，低于35的超卖线，截至11月16日收盘仍处超卖区，我的判断：观望，等企稳信号再动手。

信号先说清楚：ETH现价约1817美元，24小时在1787至1857美元之间波动，24小时微跌约0.7%。RSI 25.3意味着过去14个交易日跌势已经很极端，但超卖本身不是买入信号，超卖之后还可以继续超卖。

为什么是观望而不是看多？有三点理由。

第一，跌势放缓不等于企稳。ETH月内从2000美元上方一路下行，11月13日跌破2000美元，14日跌破1900美元，15日逼近1800美元，16日月跌幅已达26%、一度探至1700美元附近。现价1817美元只是从低点反弹了一小段，日线还没有收出企稳形态，急着进场等于接飞刀。

第二，大盘没有止跌。恐慌贪婪指数12，仍处极度恐惧；全市场总市值2.22万亿美元，24小时跌1.31%；BTC市占率58.5%，资金还在向比特币集中。ETH的超卖不是独立信号——SOL的RSI只有20.3、BTC 23.7，全市场都在超卖区，ETH的25.3程度居中，没有跑赢大盘的证据。

第三，结构面有支撑，但改变不了短期趋势。以太坊质押率36.3%创新高，长期锁仓意愿确实强；但这属于慢变量，短期价格由情绪和资金面决定。衍生品端资金费率-0.0057%，空头略占上风，也说明市场还没转向。

失效条件说在前面：日线收盘跌破1787美元，也就是24小时低点，观望逻辑失效，判断转为看空；反过来，如果日线RSI回升至40上方且收盘站稳，超卖解除，本观点作废。1787美元这个位置你认吗？看多扣1，看空扣2。

公开行情里，傍晚那篇还在约 6.43 万，刚写到 17 点 15 分最低约 6.41（64128），把夜里约 6.43（64258）砸穿了，问约 6.41 还会不会再往下挖到昨天下午约 6.38，还是能先收回约 6.43 / 约 6.50。开盘前那篇已经把镜头转到芯片：NVDA 盘前约 157（156.97），纳指期货当时日低约 2.755 万（27554），相对周五大约低了 480 点。几个小时过去了：20 点 29 分大饼又下挖到约 6.39（63905），几乎贴上昨天下午约 6.38（63777），但没穿；22 点 37 分一拉冲到约 6.57（65696），把昨早约 6.55、下午约 6.51 都甩在后面，却还是够不着周日傍晚约 6.61（66132）。今早 6 点 44 分再摸约 6.55（65535），差那一下约 6.57 大约 160 块；7 点期货开口后没有往上延，7 点 11 分最高约 6.54（65360），8 点 23 分最低约 6.45（64455）。这会儿 BTC 约 6.45 万（近 24 小时约 -1.3%），数字转红，是因为 24 小时窗口已经滚到昨天夜里冲高那截；从傍晚约 6.43 其实只是来回，从夜里约 6.57 算则吐了大约 1200。同一段时间里，美股现金盘已经收了：NVDA 收约 156.1，比周五收盘约 162.9 大约低了 4.1%，盘中最低约 155.0（155.01），周五低点约 158.4 这回没守住；纳指期货现金时段最低约 2.723 万（27235），这会儿约 2.737 万（27372），相对周五约 2.803 万大约低了 663 点。

先把夜里这截「先挖约 6.39，再冲约 6.57」说清楚。傍晚帖发出去的时候，大饼刚把夜里约 6.43 砸穿，最低停在约 6.41。17 点 26 分反抽约 6.45（64492）没摸回下午高点，18 点 27 分到约 6.47（64697），19 点 17 分约 6.48（64796），还是够不着约 6.50。真正再往下挖是 20 点 29 分那一下，最低约 6.39（63905），离昨天下午约 6.38（63777）只差大约 130 块，这回倒是没穿。21 点前后还在约 6.42 附近磨，22 点 09 分再见到约 6.40（64014），随后才是那一波急拉：22 点 37 分最高约 6.57（65696）——昨早 7 点 04 分约 6.55（65509）、上午 10 点 39 分约 6.54（65362）、下午约 6.51（65078）这几道都过去了，但周日傍晚约 6.61 一次都没碰到。冲完也没留住，23 点 16 分已经回到约 6.41（64100），几乎把这一下全部吐掉。凌晨 0 点 12 分最低约 6.42（64228），0 点 23 分反抽约 6.49（64854），约 6.50 还是没站住。后半夜多次摸到约 6.51 到约 6.52：1 点 24 分约 6.52（65150），2 点 52 分约 6.52（65190），4 点 27 分约 6.52（65229），直到 6 点 10 分约 6.55（65529）、6 点 44 分最高约 6.55（65535），还是差夜里约 6.57 那一下。

再把今早期货开口这一截摊开。7 点整 CME 开，大饼当时约 6.53（65320）；7 点 11 分最高约 6.54（65360），连 6 点 44 分约 6.55 都没摸回去，更别提夜里约 6.57。随后往下走，7 点 42 分到约 6.48（64788），8 点 23 分最低约 6.45（64455）。9 点 12 分反抽约 6.48（64758），9 点 31 分回到约 6.45（64538），9 点 45 分最高约 6.49（64932）——约 6.50 这回连边都没摸到，这会儿已经回到约 6.45。今早这截更像把夜里冲高余波吐完，而不是再往约 6.57 延伸。

ETH 夜里同样是先下后拉：20 点 29 分最低约 1787，把傍晚约 1791、夜里约 1794 又略略挖深了一点；22 点 37 分最高约 1867，跟大饼同一分钟。后半夜最高只到 6 点 12 分约 1839，今早 7 点 15 分约 1831 没摸回去，8 点 33 分最低约 1812，这会儿约 1814（约 -1.0%）。BNB 22 点 37 分最高约 598，23 点 35 分最低约 584，这会儿约 591（约 -1.1%）。SOL 还是更软的一截：22 点 37 分最高约 72.9，23 点 26 分最低约 69.9，把傍晚约 70.5 又往下挖了一刀，这会儿约 71.7（约 -1.4%）。XRP 22 点 37 分最高约 0.977，23 点 26 分又回到约 0.943，几乎贴回傍晚约 0.942，这会儿约 0.955（约 -1.7%）。

跨资产这边，现金盘已经走完了。开盘前那篇还在写纳指期货日低约 2.755 万（27554），相对周五大约低了 480 点。22 点 30 分现金开盘时纳指期货约 2.767 万（27668），22 点 45 分最高约 2.772 万（27716），连傍晚约 2.781 万、周五约 2.803 万都够不着；凌晨 4 点 38 分最低约 2.723 万（27235），5 点收在约 2.731 万（27306）附近。今早 7 点 43 分又下挖到约 2.718 万（27180），这会儿约 2.737 万（27372），相对周五大约低了 663 点。标普期货现金时段最低约 7420（3 点 47 分），这会儿约 7444，相对周五约 7583 大约低了 139 点；道指期货现金最低约 5.157 万（51574），这会儿约 5.160 万，相对周五约 5.242 万大约低了 820 点。NVDA 22 点 30 分开在约 159.0，比盘前约 157 稍高，22 点 46 分最高约 163.0 刚摸到周五收盘约 162.9 附近，随后没站住，凌晨 2 点 36 分最低约 155.0（155.01），收约 156.1，市值还在 4 万亿下方；盘后最低约 155.1，这会儿盘后报价约 155.6。AMD 收约 504，盘中最低约 501，盘后还见到约 496.7。金约 3874，油大约 85.1，比傍晚约 88.3 又掉了一截。10 年期美债收益率约 5.12%；VIX 收约 22.9，盘中最高约 24.5，比周五约 19.3 又高了一截。我不会把夜里大饼那一下约 6.57 读成风险偏好已经打开——现货冲高没留住，现金盘芯片和期货还在往周五下方走。

再往后看，美股现金盘已经收了，下一脚是今晚盘后。上海时间周三凌晨，就是黄仁勋辞职、CFO 暂代之后的第一份财报。夜里约 6.57 没站住、今早约 6.55 也没接上，和这份财报还不是同一件事，先别混在一起定价。

我个人怎么读这个周二上午（仅观察，非投资建议）：

1. 别把「夜里最高约 6.57、一度穿过昨早约 6.55」读成傍晚问的约 6.50 已经收回来了。更刺眼的是，约 6.57 上方几乎没停，23 点 16 分已经回到约 6.41；今早 6 点 44 分约 6.55 没摸回约 6.57，期货一开口反而走到约 6.45，9 点 45 分最高约 6.49，连约 6.50 都没碰到。这更像一次没留下的冲高，而不是结构已经修好。

2. 顺序盯清楚：约 6.39 这截还在昨天下午约 6.38 上方，还会不会再往下贴、甚至穿掉，还是能先收回约 6.50 → 约 6.55 / 约 6.57 → 今晚美股盘后那份 NVDA 财报，现金已经收在约 156.1、盘中低点约 155.0 下方。先别急着把夜里约 6.57 当成新的定价锚。

3. 24 小时约 -1.3% 是窗口滚到昨天夜里冲高那截之后的结果，从傍晚约 6.43 算几乎是平的，从约 6.57 算则是回吐。现金盘纳指期货相对周五大约低了 663 点，VIX 收在约 22.9，更像「夜里那一脚过热已经吐掉，现货停在约 6.45，美股这一夜并没有帮忙」的等待，而不是可以按约 6.57 来定价周二白天。

你怎么看：这算「约 6.39 没穿昨天下午约 6.38，夜里约 6.57 是过热，先回到约 6.45 正常」，还是「约 6.57 摸完就吐，今早约 6.55 也没接上，先按这道冲高已经失败来定价」？评论区聊聊。

It had just noted that at 5:15 p.m. the low was around 64,100 (64128), breaking below the overnight level of around 64,300 (64258). The question was whether it would keep falling from around 64,100 to yesterday afternoon’s roughly 63,800, or could first recover to around 64,300 / 65,000. The pre-market post had already shifted its focus to chips: NVDA was around 157 pre-market (156.97), while Nasdaq futures were at a daily low of around 27,550 (27554), about 480 points below Friday’s level. After futures opened at 7:00, it failed to extend the move higher; the peak was around 65,400 (65360) at 7:11, and the low was around 64,500 (64455) at 8:23. BTC is now around 64,500 (down about 1.3% over the past 24 hours). The figure has turned red because the 24-hour window now includes last night’s spike; compared with the evening level of around 64,300, it has mostly moved sideways, while from last night’s roughly 65,700 it has shed about 1,200. Meanwhile, the U.S. cash session has closed: NVDA finished around 156.1, about 4.1% below Friday’s close of roughly 162.9. The RSI on the 4H is cooling off around 45, suggesting there is still room for a drop before oversold conditions are met.Daily: Bitcoin is consolidating above the psychological $60,000 support. The 200-day EMA is acting as the ultimate macro floor.Key Levels:Immediate Resistance: $65,014 (MA25) and $65,600 (Recent swing high).Immediate Support: $64,700 (MA99) and $63,000 (Recent sweep low).

4. Fundamental Analysis
Bitcoin’s fundamentals remain unassailable in the current cycle. Network hashrate continues to trend upward, proving miner commitment despite fluctuating prices. Institutional infrastructure (ETFs, custodians) is fully matured in late 2026. The primary fundamental risk right now isn't the network; it's macroeconomic liquidity. If central banks tighten or hold rates longer than expected, risk assets like BTC will face headwinds regardless of on-chain strength.

5. Latest Market News & Events
Institutional Flows: Spot BTC ETF flows have been mixed over the last 7 days, showing net zero to slight outflows, which explains the lack of upward momentum.Regulatory: Global stablecoin regulations are tightening, which indirectly impacts crypto liquidity.Macro: Upcoming CPI and Fed commentary this week are the primary catalysts. The market is pricing in a "higher for longer" rate environment, which suppresses speculative leverage.

6. Whale & On-Chain Analysis
Exchange Balances: Net exchange balances are slightly declining, indicating long-term holders are moving coins to cold storage. This is a bullish structural signal, but it doesn't prevent short-term price drops.Whale Activity: On-chain data shows whales accumulating in the $60k-$62k range. They are not aggressively buying at $64.8k.Derivatives: Funding rates are flat. Open Interest is slightly decreasing, meaning leverage is being flushed out. This is healthy and reduces the risk of a sudden long-squeeze.

7. Bullish vs Bearish Scenarios

Trigger: A high-volume 1-hour candle close above $65,050 (clearing the MA25).Catalyst: Positive macroeconomic data or a surprise institutional inflow.Target: Re-test of $65,600, followed by a push to $68,000.Invalidation: Failure to hold $64,700 on a retest.

BEARISH SCENARIO:
Trigger: Rejection at the MA25 ($65,014) followed by a break below the MA99 ($64,764).Catalyst: Strong dollar index (DXY) rally or negative regulatory news.Target: Retest of the liquidity sweep at $63,005, and potentially a wick down to $61,500 to clear remaining early longs.Invalidation: A sudden volume spike reclaiming $65,000.

8. Price Prediction
Next 24–48 Hours: Chop. Expect a tight range between $64,200 and $65,100. The market needs to build a base.Next 7 Days: If $63,000 holds, a grind back to $66,500 is likely. If $63,000 breaks, expect a flush to $60,500.Next 30 Days: Highly dependent on macro liquidity. Bullish target: $72,000. Bearish target: $58,000.Confidence Level: Low for short-term direction (40%), High for medium-term range-bound consolidation (75%).

9. Professional Trading Strategy
Do not trade the 15-minute chart shown in the image. The volume is too low, and the noise-to-signal ratio is terrible.

Strategy: Wait for a 4-hour confirmation.Long Entry Zone: $63,200 - $63,500 (Retest of the liquidity sweep support).Confirmation Signal: 4H bullish engulfing candle or a strong rejection wick at this level.Stop-Loss: $62,400 (Strict invalidation).Take Profit 1: $64,800Take Profit 2: $65,600Take Profit 3: $67,500Risk-to-Reward: 1:2.5Futures Risk: Funding is neutral, but a sudden spike in leverage could trigger a hunt for the $63,000 low again. Keep leverage below 5x.

10. Final Market Verdict
Overall Direction: Neutral / Consolidation.Strongest Bullish Signal: The aggressive wick down to $63,005 and immediate recovery shows strong underlying demand at lower levels.Strongest Bearish Warning: The 15m volume is anemic, and price is capped by the 25 MA. Buyers are not stepping in aggressively at current prices.Major Support: $63,000Major Resistance: $65,600Best Action: WAIT. Do not chase this minor bounce. Let the price come to your limit orders at $63,200, or wait for a definitive 4-hour breakout above $65,100.
11. FINAL $BTC 

If you’re looking at the 15-minute chart and thinking this minor bounce from $63,000 is your cue to go long, you’re trading noise, not structure.Bitcoin is currently sitting at $64,815, recovering from a sharp wick down to $63,005. On the surface, it looks like buyers stepped in to defend the level. But let’s stress-test that assumption before you risk your capital.The Volume Problem
Look closely at the volume on this recent recovery. It’s incredibly thin. A bounce without heavy volume is just a lack of sellers, not a surge in buyers. Price is currently trapped below the 25-period Moving Average ($65,014). Until Bitcoin can aggressively clear $65,050 on the 1-hour chart with actual volume, this is just a bear market rally inside a consolidation range.The Liquidity Sweep
The real story here isn't the bounce; it's the drop. The wick down to $63,005 was a classic liquidity sweep. Market makers pushed the price down to trigger stop-losses and liquidate over-leveraged early longs. Once that liquidity was grabbed, the price snapped back. This tells us that $63,000 is a highly defended zone, but it doesn't mean the top is in.What You Need to See
For the bulls to take control, we need a 4-hour candle close above $65,100. That clears the immediate moving average resistance and opens the path to retest the $65,600 swing high.For the bears, if we lose $64,700 (the 99 MA) and start printing lower lows on the 1-hour chart, expect a retest of $63,000. If that breaks, $61,500 is the next logical target to clear out the remaining weak hands.The Macro Reality
Fundamentally, Bitcoin is stronger than ever. Hashrate is at all-time highs, and institutional infrastructure is fully mature. But crypto doesn't trade in a vacuum. If the broader macro environment stays tight and liquidity remains constrained, Bitcoin will continue to chop in this $60,000 to $66,000 range until a major catalyst forces a breakout.The Verdict
Stop chasing 15-minute green candles. The smart money is sitting on their hands, waiting for the range extremes. If you want to long, set your bids near $63,200. If you want to short, wait for a rejection at $65,500.Trading the middle of a chop zone is the fastest way to bleed your account. Wait for the market to show its hand.What’s your next move? Are you buying the $63k dip, or waiting for a breakout above $65.5k? Let me know in the comments.12. Hashtags#Bitcoin #BTC #CryptoTrading #TechnicalAnalysis #BinanceSquare13. Stop-loss: Above 1870
Take-profit target: 1800–1785

11 月 17 日 ETH 反弹动能持续衰减，反抽承压优先高空

生态层面，近期以太坊链上 Gas 价格持续处于低位，DeFi 锁仓量与链上交易活跃度环比回落，生态端缺少重磅利好叙事，基本面暂无向上驱动的发力点。

【今日思路】
空单入场区间：反弹 1840—1855 布局
止损设置：1870 上方
止盈设置：目标 1800—1785

【核心逻辑】
30 分钟级别下探 1786 低点后走出一波超跌反抽，冲高至 1866.83 后快速回落，反弹并未突破下行趋势的关键压制位，整体仍处于下跌通道内的弱势修复阶段，并未形成趋势反转。MACD 在零轴下方反弹后再度拐头向下，红柱快速收窄，多头反弹动能衰减速度快、持续性不足，叠加公链板块整体情绪偏弱，ETH 缺乏独立上行动能，后续承压回落的概率更高。上方 1840-1855 是本轮反弹的筹码密集承压区，价格反抽至此抛压集中释放，顺势高空的盈亏比更优，也更贴合当前弱势联动的盘面节奏。#ETH #本周财报与宏观事件密集，市场再迎波动考验

ETH Fund Flows Updated Yesterday | Net Outflow Still Provisional | Wait for Complete Flow Data Above 1,800

My stance is to stick to discipline and not treat an incomplete ETF flow table as confirmation of a full-scale retreat. Farside’s November 16 line for U.S. spot Ethereum funds currently shows a provisional net outflow of $8.4 million: so far, FETH shows a $5 million outflow, ETHE a $4.4 million outflow, and another Grayscale ETH product a $1 million inflow; ETHA, ETHB, and ETHV are still marked with dashes, meaning they have not reported—not that their flows are zero. The relatively complete November 13 line showed a net inflow of $2.3 million. This change indicates selling pressure among the products that have reported, but the total may still change as missing figures come in. In particular, do not misstate the “provisional $8.4 million net outflow” as the final November 16 figure, and do not infer from a single day’s data that institutions have given up on ETH.

Why do fund flows matter? Spot ETF creations and redemptions may be transmitted to spot demand through authorized participants and custodial channels, and persistent outflows can make the market more cautious. But different funds can see outflows and inflows at the same time, while fees, conversions, and investor allocation behavior across share classes can also affect the figures. Farside’s page has a separate note about ETHE and seed conversions, so historical totals should not be equated directly with today’s new buying or selling. Looking only at the fund table also misses on-chain demand, staking, and macro risk appetite. I just checked the SEC website and the Ethereum Foundation: regulatory filings and protocol upgrade timelines each follow their own schedules; neither proves the cause of the figures in this fund table. To confirm whether fund flows are creating sustained pressure, we need at least to wait for missing products to report, observe net flows over several consecutive days, and see whether price breaks key levels at the same time.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,820.54, down about 0.28% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,787.11 to $1,866.89. Price is above $1,800 but has clearly not reclaimed the highs near $1,867; this is consistent with the view that fund-flow signals remain weak and the trend is unconfirmed, but it is not enough to prove that today’s decline was driven entirely by ETF outflows. My levels to watch are $1,800 and $1,787 as downside defenses, $1,835 as a short-term reclaim level, and $1,867 as the top of the range. If missing data comes in and turns the total to a net inflow, or price decisively moves above $1,835 and then breaks $1,867, I should revise my current cautious view. If price falls below $1,787 and fails to rebound, the hold-above-support assumption is invalidated. A Russian central bank rule allowing retail access to ETH within an eligible scope also takes effect today. That opens an institutional channel; it does not amount to measurable immediate buying, and I will not use it to offset the incomplete fund data.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I would consider is a conditional, unleveraged spot long, with a 0% position. I would wait for the missing ETF figures to come in and for ETH to close above $1,835 on the one-hour chart and hold $1,825 on a retest, then test the trade with no more than 0.6% of total capital. The first target is $1,867; I would take half off there, let the rest run toward $1,900, and move the stop higher. If an hourly close falls back below $1,800 after entry, I would stop out immediately. If price breaks below $1,787 first, or incoming fund figures significantly increase the net outflow, I would cancel the plan and remain flat. When data is incomplete, waiting another round is more consistent with my trading principles than increasing a position amid rumors and missing figures.

content:
ETH基金昨日报数更新｜净流出仍是暂列｜1800上方先等资金齐数

我的态度是守住纪律，不把尚未报齐的ETF资金表当作已确认的全面撤退。Farside在11月16日美国以太坊现货基金一行暂列净流出840万美元：目前能看到FETH流出500万美元、ETHE流出440万美元、另一只Grayscale ETH产品流入100万美元；ETHA、ETHB和ETHV仍是横杠，表示未填报，不能视为零。11月13日相对完整的一行是净流入230万美元。这个变化说明已更新产品出现卖压，但总量还会随缺项补报而变动。尤其不要把“暂列净流出840万”误写成11月16日最终统计，更不要从单日数据推导出机构已经放弃ETH。

基金净流量为何重要？现货ETF申赎可能通过授权参与者和托管渠道传导到现货需求，连续流出时市场会更谨慎。但不同基金的流出和流入可能同时存在，且不同份额的费用、转换及投资者配置行为也会影响数字。Farside页面对ETHE和ETH种子转换另有注释，不能把历史总量直接等同今日新增买卖。只看基金表也会遗漏链上需求、质押和宏观风险偏好。刚才我核对了SEC网站和以太坊基金会：监管文件、协议升级进度各有自己的时间线，它们不是这张基金表的原因证明。要确认资金是否形成持续压力，至少还需等缺失产品填报、连续数日净流向及价格是否同步失守关键位。

市场已经怎样反应？写稿时币安ETH/USDT约1820.54美元，24小时跌约0.28%，区间1787.11至1866.89。价格在1800上方，但明显未收复1867附近高位；这与“资金信号仍偏弱、趋势未确认”的判断相容，却不足以证明今天的下跌完全由ETF流出驱动。我的观察位是1800、1787的下方防线，1835的短线收复位以及1867的区间上沿。若缺失数据补报后转为净流入，或价格有效站上1835并继续突破1867，当前谨慎判断就应被修正；若跌破1787且反抽无力，守稳假设被推翻。另有俄罗斯央行允许合资格范围内零售接触ETH的规则今日生效，那是制度入口，不等于可计量即时买盘，我不会拿它抵消基金未报齐的缺口。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅考虑无杠杆现货条件多单，仓位0%。我会等ETF缺项补齐，同时ETH一小时收盘站上1835、回踩守住1825，再用总资金最多0.6%试单；第一目标1867，到位减仓一半，余仓看1900并把止损上移。若入场后小时收盘跌回1800，立即止损平仓；若价格先破1787或基金补数显著扩大净流出，计划取消，继续空仓。数据不完整时多等一轮，比在传闻和缺项中扩大仓位更符合我的交易原则。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s hard to trade futures without USDT, but many people have never wondered why it’s worth $1.

[How it works] A stablecoin is operated by an issuer: you give it $1, and it gives you 1 USDT, while depositing
dollars (and equivalent assets) into reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can apply to the issuer
for redemption from the issuer. This “mint-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
The price may occasionally deviate slightly (for example, to 0.999), but arbitrageurs quickly step in to close the gap.

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至北京时间十一月十七日凌晨，以太坊报价一千八百一十八美元，过去二十四小时内小幅上涨百分之零点四二，表现略优于比特币。从小时级别K线来看，以太坊在过去五个小时内同样经历了一波回调，从一千八百二十九美元的高点回落至一千八百一十一美元的日内低点，随后在买盘支撑下反弹至一千八百二十美元附近企稳。与比特币相比，以太坊的回调幅度相对温和，显示出一定的抗跌性，多空双方在关键位置展开了激烈博弈。

从均线系统来看，当前价格运行在七日均线一千八百二十二美元附近，略低于该均线，同时位于二十五日均线一千八百一十八美元的上方，短期均线呈现粘合状态，方向尚不明朗。九十九小时均线位于一千八百五十九美元，距离当前价格约四十美元，中期压力位较为明确。指数移动平均线方面，七日指数均线一千八百二十一点六与二十五日指数均线一千八百二十点三几乎重合，形成了关键的短期分水岭。一旦价格有效突破这一区域，可能引发更大级别的行情波动。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标显示，快线零点八六七高于慢线零点五九一，柱状图零点二七六为正值，虽然较前期有所收窄，但多头格局尚未被打破，显示以太坊的短期动能仍然偏多。RSI方面，六周期RSI报五十二点七一，十二周期RSI报五十一六十，二十四周期RSI报四十九点零二，短周期RSI已经回升至五十上方，显示短线买盘力量有所恢复，但中长周期RSI仍在中轴附近徘徊，整体处于多空平衡状态。

KDJ指标中K值三十七点三八，D值三十八点零一，J值三十六点一二，三线均处于中低位区域且相互粘合，尚未形成明确的方向信号。布林带方面，上轨一千八百四十点八八，中轨一千八百一十八点一八，下轨一千七百九十五点四八，价格运行在中轨附近，带宽适中，短期可能维持区间震荡格局。ATR波动率报十七点六三美元，较前期有所下降，市场波动性降低。威廉指标报负六十三点五一，处于偏弱区域。综合来看，以太坊的技术面呈现出中性偏多的特征，MACD维持金叉状态是主要的多头支撑信号。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪呈现出与比特币不同的结构性特征。从机构动向来看，多家企业实体在过去一周内增持了超过十二万枚以太坊，其中BitMine Immersion单次增持七千六百五十三枚以太坊，机构总持仓达到约六百零八万枚以太坊，占流通供应量的百分之四点九七，企业层面的持续买入为价格提供了坚实的底部支撑。然而，现货以太坊ETF仍然面临每周约三亿九千八百八十五万美元的净流出压力，净资产规模缩水至二百一十七亿七千八百万美元，机构层面的分歧依然明显。

从生态发展角度来看，俄罗斯 finalized了加密货币零售交易框架，同时注册货币市场基金开始在以太坊上部署，传统金融对以太坊生态的认可度正在持续提升。链上数据显示，近期单小时现货成交量一度飙升至两亿一千六百五十万美元，净流入超过两千万美元，推动价格从一千八百零三美元快速拉升至一千八百四十六美元，显示出市场对以太坊仍有较强的承接意愿。综合研判，以太坊短线可能维持一千八百至一千八百五十美元的区间震荡，中期需关注能否有效突破一千八百六十美元的九十九小时均线压力位。投资者应关注ETF资金流向的变化以及全球宏观环境对市场风险偏好的影响。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being Flat Is a Position Too—and the One Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and volatility wear away their capital.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat,
When the market is a tug-of-war between bulls and bears, stay flat. After a few losing trades in a row, stay flat. The money you save in these three moments
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but it holds true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital ready, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have ammunition. Hold on to your bullets.

【After a high-volume sell-off, I'm in no rush to run】

The thing I fear most in trading isn't a drop—it's a drop with no buyers stepping in, followed by a rebound on weak volume. ETH is currently at $1,817.58, up 0.7% over 24 hours and down 14.4% over 7 days. It looks steady on the surface, but in reality this is a weak rebound after a sharp decline. $1,751.04 is the critical level: if it fails to hold, the trend turns bearish. $1,895.62 is the threshold; only a breakout on rising volume would mean the bulls have truly regained the initiative.

Trading volume has surged abnormally, exceeding 5% of market cap. Bulls and bears are switching positions—this isn't quiet consolidation. My call: wait and see, with a bullish bias. The Fear Index is just 12, with a weekly average of 17; pessimism is nearing capitulation, while institutional treasuries are disclosing ETH purchases. Capital hasn't fully retreated. Holding above $1,751.04 is a bullish signal; breaking below it turns the signal bearish; only moving above $1,895.62 would count as a genuine breakout.

In practical terms, institutions such as Bitmine are adding ETH to their treasuries, while Binance Pay Later now lets users access credit against their ETH holdings. This suggests ETH is moving beyond “crypto speculation” toward treasury reserves and collateral for consumer spending. Long-term holders, merchants, and lending platforms are the ones most affected. If these use cases continue to grow, ETH's on-chain settlement and collateral value could be repriced. The business case is viable, but credit limits and buyback volumes aren't unlimited, and purchases don't mean demand has no ceiling.

Which way are you leaning: go long if $1,751.04 holds, or wait for a short after it breaks?

translatedData.content:
Opening websites you use every day, like the BBC or Zoom, or copying a wallet address could quietly result in it being replaced with someone else’s. This isn’t a phishing message—it’s the result of malicious code being added to a third-party script loaded by the website itself.

On November 16, security firm Report URI discovered that malicious code had been added to project scripts for Optimizely, a web experimentation tool used by multiple websites. Visitors would load the code just by opening a page. The “at least 186 websites” figure mentioned in trending posts matches their investigation between 19:24 and 19:59 UTC that day (3:24–3:59 a.m. Beijing time on November 17): they initially found 186 compromised scripts among the 1,611 they could check. A subsequent review of the same set put the number at 188 infected scripts affecting 178 organizations. The list included Zoom, the BBC, CNN, HSBC, and the hardware wallet website Ledger. They noted that the actual number could be higher, since they could only inspect scripts they were able to locate at the time. The attack has been dubbed OPTIMJACK.

Here are the most important things for everyday users to know 👇

🔹 Copied addresses could be swapped out. The malicious script can recognize legitimate Bitcoin, Ethereum and other EVM-chain, TRON, Solana, TON, Bitcoin Cash, and Dogecoin addresses, and replace text on the page, entries in forms, links, and addresses just copied to the clipboard with addresses controlled by the attackers. Copying on an infected page—or copying from somewhere else while that tab is open—could result in a changed address being pasted. Always double-check the address before sending a transfer. If you use a hardware wallet, trust the address displayed on its screen.

🔹 Websites’ own payment forms may have had card details skimmed. The same script began collecting card numbers, expiration dates, and security codes at 13:43 UTC on the 16th. When using hosted fields from providers like Stripe or Adyen (where the page embeds the payment company’s own fields), the script can’t access them. Card details entered directly into a website’s own form aren’t covered by that protection. If you entered card details into a site’s own form on the 16th, keep an eye on your statements.

🔹 The cryptocurrency known to have been stolen is a minimum, not the full extent of the losses. As of 19:25 UTC on the 16th (3:25 a.m. Beijing time on November 17), the attackers’ wallets had received about $7,040 on-chain, all within roughly nine hours that day. Investigators can’t see how many card numbers and cookies were stolen.

🔹 Don’t rely on early reports from that day saying the “attack is ongoing.” Report URI records show that a large-scale cleanup took place at around 20:40–21:10 UTC (4:40–5:10 a.m. Beijing time on November 17). The Ledger script was cleaned up at around 20:41 UTC, and the BBC’s at around 21:07 UTC. By 21:52 UTC, only one of the 188 infected scripts still contained malicious code. The scripts being clean now doesn’t mean addresses weren’t swapped or card details skimmed on the 16th.

There’s no public conclusion yet on how the attackers gained write access to so many projects belonging to unrelated customers. As of the evening of the 16th, Optimizely had not issued a statement. Also, some iPhones and iPads were served an exploit kit, but there’s no confirmation that any actual device was successfully compromised. Don’t conclude from this that your phone has been hacked—but do keep your operating system up to date.

If you visited websites like these on the 16th, double-check the address before making a transfer, and keep an eye on your statements. Confirm only once the address matches.

content:
打开BBC、Zoom这种天天用的网站，复制个钱包地址，都可能被悄悄换成别人的。这不是钓鱼私信，是网站自己加载的第三方脚本被做了手脚。

11月16日，安全公司Report URI发现，多家网站使用的网页试验工具Optimizely，其项目脚本被写入恶意代码，访客打开页面就会加载。热搜说的「至少186个网站」，对得上他们当天19:24至19:59 UTC（北京时间17日3:24至3:59）的排查：在1611个可查脚本里先数到186个中招。随后同一批核查把数字落到188个被植入脚本、涉及178家机构，名单里有Zoom、BBC、CNN、HSBC，也有硬件钱包官网Ledger。他们写明，实际数量可能还更高，因为只能检查当时找得到的脚本。这次攻击被称作OPTIMJACK。

对普通用户，这几条最要紧👇

🔹 复制地址会被掉包。恶意脚本会识别比特币、以太坊及其他EVM链、TRON、Solana、TON、比特币现金、狗狗币的合法地址，把页面文字、输入框、链接，以及剪贴板里刚复制的地址，换成攻击者的地址。在中招页面上复制，或在该标签页开着时从别处复制，都可能贴出被改过的地址。转账前务必再核对一遍，用硬件钱包的话，以屏幕上显示的地址为准。

🔹 网站自己的支付表单可能被读卡。同一套脚本从16日13:43 UTC起会抓卡号、有效期和安全码。用Stripe、Adyen这类托管输入框（页面上嵌的是支付公司自己的框）时，脚本够不着；直接打在网站自己表单里的卡信息则不在这个保护范围内。16日在相关网站自建表单里输过卡的，需要留意账单。

🔹 已知被转走的币是下限，不是全部损失。截至16日19:25 UTC（北京时间17日3:25），攻击者钱包链上大约收到7040美元，都发生在当天约9小时内。卡号和Cookie被偷了多少，排查方看不到。

🔹 别再用当天早些时候「攻击仍在持续」的快讯口径。Report URI记录，约20:40至21:10 UTC（北京时间17日4:40至5:10）出现大规模清理，Ledger脚本约20:41 UTC、BBC约21:07 UTC被清掉；21:52 UTC时，188个被感染脚本里只剩1个还带毒。脚本现在干净，也不等于16日当天没被掉包或读卡。

攻击者怎么拿到这么多互不相关客户项目的写入权限，目前还没有公开结论；截至16日晚，Optimizely尚未发布说明。另外，部分iPhone、iPad访问时被投递了漏洞利用程序，但尚未证实有真机被成功入侵，不必据此断言手机已被攻破；系统该更新还是要更新。

如果你16日打开过上述这类网站，转账前多核一次地址，账单也盯一眼。地址对得上，再按确认。

translatedData.content:
Two ETH transfers into Coinbase look more like a "pending disposal signal" than evidence that selling has already been completed. Whether my judgment holds depends on whether the subsequent address balances and exchange flows continue to move in the same direction.

According to a PANews report on November 17 citing Ai Yi monitoring, three addresses belonging to the same entity or large holder deposited 1,350 ETH to Coinbase 9 hours ago, worth about $2.45 million. This batch of ETH was withdrawn in December 2022 at an average price of $1,271, and the holder did not take profit when ETH broke above $4,500. Another item on the same day, citing Lookonchain, said a wallet possibly linked to Arthur Hayes deposited 1,500 ETH into Coinbase, worth about $2.73 million. The two transfers total 2,850 ETH, but one is attributed to the "same entity or large holder," while the other is only "possibly linked"; neither identity is confirmed.

My observation is that an on-chain "deposit to an exchange" only shows that assets have entered a tradable venue; it does not constitute an executed sell order. After long-term holding, older addresses choosing to transfer in often indicate rising intent to dispose, but the real selling pressure must be verified by combined evidence of net exchange inflows, declining address balances, and trading data. If ETH continues to remain on the exchange and the related addresses' balances fall to zero, the liquidation judgment becomes more credible; if it is later withdrawn to self-custody addresses, it is more likely to be a custody adjustment or an off-exchange arrangement.

Based on this, three things are worth tracking in the short term: whether Coinbase-related net ETH inflows continue, whether the above address balances keep declining, and whether the two attributions are confirmed by more explicit on-chain labels. Before evidence for both identity and executed trades is available, directly equating "suspected liquidation" with "already dumped" is not well supported. This article does not constitute investment advice.

$BTC: Why Rumors Should Never Be Published as Market Facts

Why does the observation that $BTC moved down hourly while volume was 2.27x baseline invite more caution than confidence? The recorded data shows a downward hourly direction and volume above baseline, yet the price remains inside the recorded range between 64454.5 and 65534.9. This creates a dilemma: a reader might treat the volume spike as proof of a larger trend, while the range suggests limited movement.

A common assumption is that higher relative volume confirms price direction. The counterexample is that volume can rise on short‑term noise, leaving the asset trapped in its range. One way to test the assumption is to wait for the next closed candle and see whether the price breaches 65534.9 or drops below 64454.5. If the candle closes beyond these bounds, the volume reading gains relevance; if it stays within, the earlier interpretation weakens.

The broader lesson is information hygiene. Verify each metric against its context before drawing conclusions. Ask whether the evidence changes the probability of a breakout or simply reflects typical market churn. By separating the raw observation from persuasive framing, readers can avoid over‑reliance on a single data point and maintain a balanced view.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

For a wider view: $ETH has hourly direction down and volume above its baseline; $HUMA has hourly direction down and volume not above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.
